issues.description: Field 'Bitmap24::data' has conflicting types between the template header and the implementation/solution. In the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the member is declared as 'int *data' while the template implementation (example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp) allocates and uses a byte buffer via 'new char[...]' and the solution header declares 'char *data'. This type mismatch between the header and the implementation/solution will produce compilation errors (type mismatch, incorrect delete[] usage) and will block students from building and running the example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24::data member type consistent with its usage. Change the declaration in the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) from 'int *data;' to 'char *data;'. Ensure the rest of the template code uses 'char *' consistently (allocation with new char[...], assignments, and delete[] data). This aligns the template with the implementation and the solution and prevents compilation/type errors.
